question: Kirti Kisan Party (KKP) was established on ______ at Amritsar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12th April 1927**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kirti Kisan Party (KKP)** was established on **12th April 1927** in **Amritsar** with the primary objective of uniting and mobilizing workers and peasants to address socio-economic injustices under British colonial rule and oppressive landlords
 
• The KKP was an offshoot of the **Kirti movement**, which originated from the activities of the **Ghadar Party**.
 
 
• Many leaders of the Ghadar Party, after returning to India from abroad, decided to focus on agrarian and labor issues as a means to resist colonial oppression.
 
• The **"Kirti" (Worker)** publication became the voice of these efforts, spreading awareness and advocating for social and economic equality.
 
• The party was led by prominent Ghadarites and leftist leaders, such as **Santokh Singh**, **Bhagat Singh**, and others who were deeply influenced by socialist principles.
